. Each step names the script, the folder it is run from, the command, its inputs and its outputs. Scripts that are no longer part of the pipeline are listed in
together with the reason, so that the decision does not have to be taken again.

The chapter covers the analysis of participant data. Training the two neural networks (the model classifier and the posterior network) and validating them on simulated data is a separate, much longer computation that is only repeated when the model changes. It is described in
; the pipeline below assumes that the trained networks exist.
